title: Memory safety bugs fixed in Thunderbird 150.0.1
description: CVE-2026-7324 is a memory safety vulnerability identified in Microsoft software version 4.0. The issue relates to memory safety bugs, specifically categorized under CWE-119. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. There is no indication of known exploitation in the wild, and no patch or remediation details are available in the provided data.
